h2. The problem

When you search, each type of record shows only the first five matches, even when it says there are
twenty. There is no way to see the rest from the search box. The heading counts them - "Work orders
(20)" - and then offers nothing to open them with. The only way to reach the sixth match is to guess
different words to type.

h2. Steps to reproduce

# Sign in and click the Search control at the top right of any page (or press Ctrl and K together).
# Type {{Fib}}.
# Look at the heading that reads "Work orders (20)".
# Count the job lines underneath it: there are five.
# Look along that heading, and below the five lines, for anything that would open the other fifteen.
# Do the same on the "Assets (6)" heading further down: six matches, five lines, nothing to open the sixth.

h2. Screenshots

!SV-10159.png|width=760!

_Searching "Fib" on the test branch. The heading counts twenty matching jobs, five are listed, and
nothing on the heading or under the list offers the rest. Assets does the same with six._

h2. Current behaviour

* A group heading shows the type and its match count, and nothing else.
* Exactly five lines are listed under it, however many matched.
* There is nothing on the heading, under the list, or on hover that opens the full list for that type.
* The same on every group that has more than five matches.

h2. Expected behaviour

* A group with more than five matches carries a link on its heading reading "Show all 20".
* A group with five or fewer matches carries no such link.
* Choosing that link keeps you inside the search box and switches it to that type, showing up to
  twenty lines.

----

*Environment:* the new search on the test branch https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com (build
{{v26.36.7-29ca209}}), signed in as an administrator, observed 17 September 2026. The records used
are the seeded {{ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge}} companies and their jobs, which are on the branch now.

h2. Sources

{quote}
When a result group has more than five matches, a "Show all N" link appears on that group's heading
(for example "Show all 12"). A group with five or fewer matches shows no "Show all" link. N never
reads higher than 20. The "Show all" link is available for every entity group, including Assets.
{quote}
Global Search - Product Requirements, version 1.5, section 5.2 (Show all; counts capped at 20) -
Confluence page 576978945.

{quote}
Show all link behaviour: switches the modal into the corresponding scope tab.
{quote}
Same document, section 5.2.
